subject: Service true-up: bridging charge payment plan proposal
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Evan Mercer <evan.mercer@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service true-up: Q4 spike and settlement options

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the call earlier. We finished the Q4 usage reconciliation for your account and wanted to share what we found and propose a couple of settlement options so you can pick whichever fits procurement best. Summary:

- Committed capacity: 20,000 inference hours / quarter (Dedicated pool)
- Actual Q4 consumption: 65,400 inference hours (surge due to a pilot of the realtime recommendations flow)
- Delta (over-commit): 45,400 inference hours
- Unit rate (per inference hour in your plan): $0.405
- Raw overage: $18,387.00 (rounded)

Attachments: usage_report_q4.csv (detailed hourly breakdown), invoice_draft_v1.pdf (pro forma one-off invoice).

We recognize a single large invoice is disruptive. Two options we can offer:

1) One-time settlement: net $18,387 due on receipt of invoice (standard 30-day terms).
2) Amortized payment plan: spread the charge over 3 months (3 equal invoices of $6,129 plus a one-time $350 admin fee), with Redwood applying a $1,000 goodwill credit to next renewal if you commit to a 12-month expanded capacity by Feb 15.

If you prefer a different cadence (2 or 6 months) we can produce an amortization schedule. For procurement we can provide line-item detail and a PO-ready invoice. If helpful, Ben can join the PO/AR thread to speed things along.

Please let us know which option you prefer and the billing/contact info to send the invoice to (and whether ClearWave will issue a PO or pay via bank transfer).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the usage report.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage_report_q4.csv (92 KB)
Attachment: invoice_draft_v1.pdf (48 KB)

Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service true-up: Q4 spike and settlement options

Jasmine —

Thanks for the quick reconciliation and the clear options. Confirms what we suspected: the recommendation pilot drove the spike. Procurement will need line-item detail for their PO. A couple of questions from our side:

- Can you provide a daily breakdown for the top 10 spike days (we saw a handful of 8–12k-hour days; need to justify spend patterns).
- Would Redwood consider amortizing over 3 months? That is the most workable for our budget cadence.
- Will the $1,000 goodwill credit require a signed amendment to the renewal (we may need legal review)?

I’ll loop in Maya (CC’d) — she’ll own processing the PO and confirming payment terms. If amortizing, we prefer ACH rather than credit card.

I’ll ask Maya to send the PO number once she has the line items.

— Evan
Evan Mercer
Director, Cloud Ops | ClearWave Health
evan.mercer@clearwave.com | +1 206-555-0912

- Principal: $18,387.00
- Admin fee: $350 (one-time)
- Goodwill credit: $1,000 applied to next renewal if a 12‑month capacity increase is signed by Feb 15, 2027

- Payment methods accepted: ACH (preferred), wire, or credit card (card subject to 2.9% processing fee).
- Invoice remit: AR-payments@clearwave.com (confirm if different)

I’ve prepared an amortization_schedule.xlsx and adjusted-invoice-v2.pdf (attached) that reflect the above. If you need net-45 terms we can discuss, but standard is net-30 for one-offs.

If this works, please confirm and share the PO number (or confirm that Maya will route a PO to AR-payments@clearwave.com). We’ll generate the final invoice and issue immediately upon receipt of PO.

Happy to jump on a short call with procurement if that helps close the loop faster.

Thanks,
